meta.title: The Red Umbrella — Complete Example
meta.logline: A tea seller gets one last chance with the woman who left.
meta.synopsis: On a rainy night, Meera returns to Ravi's tea stall. By dawn she must decide whether to board the train.

script:
INT. TEA STALL - NIGHT #1#

Rain hammers a tin roof. RAVI (30s) wipes glasses. MEERA (20s) enters, soaked, clutching a red umbrella.

MEERA
ఒక టీ ఇవ్వండి, please.

RAVI
You came back.

CUT TO:

EXT. RAILWAY PLATFORM - DAWN #1A#

Mist. Meera waits alone with the red umbrella. A train horn in the distance.

RAVI
(off screen)
Meera! Wait!

MEERA
I waited three years.

FADE OUT.

skills.name: Intimate Drama
skills.body:
---
name: Intimate Drama
type: direction
---
# Intimate Drama
- Favor close coverage when emotion peaks.
- Hold on reactions longer than lines.
- Let silence play; cut on looks, not words.

skills.name: Naturalistic Light
skills.body:
---
name: Naturalistic Light
type: cinematography
---
# Naturalistic Light
- Motivated sources only.
- 35mm and 50mm primes, f/2-2.8.
- Handheld for emotional scenes.

skills.name: Continuity and timing
skills.body:
# Continuity and timing

Preserve the line of action; cut on reactions and budget every shot in frames.

skills.name: Rain to dawn palette
skills.body:
# Rain to dawn palette

Preserve skin tones and red umbrella; move from warm amber interiors to cool blue dawn.

skills.name: Rain and rail soundscape
skills.body:
# Rain and rail soundscape

Prioritize dialogue, maintain rain beds and use the train horn to bridge the scene transition.
